generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Valid KPWD Class III Civil License & above
Valid License obtained with the Labour Department to be enclosed
Conditional tenders will not be accepted
Tenderer should have Provided Valid copy of Group Insurance policy for Labors /employees
The tenderer shall bear all costs associated with the preparation and submission of his tender, and the employer will in no case be responsible and liable for those costs
The employer is not responsible for any delay in accessing E - Procurement Portal

As per Karnataka state Government order LD/300/LET/2006 Bangalore dated 01.01.2007 and Government letter no PW/134/BMS/2007 dated 27.07.2007, a sum amounting to 1% of the bill amount will be deducted towards constructions labour welfare fund
All the formats prescribed in the bid document shall be filled by the tenderer in complete manner

All scanned documents to be uploaded shall be in original, Submit the original document at the time of technical bid opening or next day and the Executive Engineer reserves the right to verify the original documents before approval

If any, additional information required, the same may be obtained from the office of the Executive Engineer, PWD, No. 2 Building Division, Bangalore during office hours on all working days. It may be noted that if any of the dates mentioned above happened to be a General Holiday, the next working day will be considered
The employer reserves the rights to Reject or accept any or all the tenders without assigning any reasons

The contractors assessed available tender capacity shall be more than the tender value, it will be calculated as per the Standard tender document Attached. Ongoing works list/commitments self attested to be uploaded
The Tender processing fee shall not be refundable
Contractor should follow strictly the prevailing rules of labour laws and minimum wages act

The Bidder shall not furnish any fake/fabricated/false information or withhold facts etc., if the bidder is found to have violated any of these above (found either during evaluation or after awarding the tender), the tender shall be rejected and action as per rules and regulations shall be taken against the Bidder

If the Successful Bidder has quoted lesser rates than the estimated rates then he should remit the Unbalanced Tender Amount along with the Security Deposit within the stipulated time as that shall be specified in the Letter of Acceptance, failing which the tender of the Successful Bidder shall be rejected
The intending tenderer is instructed to note that they should abide by the detailed instructions and conditions contained in the standard tender documents KW-3 K.P.W.D. and further orders there on
The quoted rates by the bidder shall be EXCLUDING GST
Valid G.S.T. Registration Certificate
Valid Professional Tax Registration Certificate
Tenderer Shall note, that the tenderers those found eligible to the conditions mentioned in Section-3 Qualification Instructions to Tenderers(ITT) will only be considered for further evaluation

Bidder Should upload the bid capacity calculated as per KW-3 Tender condition, the statements showing the value of existing commitment and on-going works as well as the stipulated period of completion remaining for each of the works listed should be countersigned by the employer in charge, not below the rank of an Executive Engineer or Equivalent. False representations in the statements leads to disqualification of the tender as per clause 3.1
Bidder shall pay Contract Management Module processing fees of 0.025% of the contact value (Min Rs.500/- & Max Rs.7500/-) soon after contract has been issued to bidder

The tenderer shall obtain the work done certificate in the prescribed format from the competent Authority Executive Engineer (District level Officer) and scan the original Certificate and attach the scanned file Certificate/ Certificates, which shall be produced at the time of opening of technical Bids for physical verification
Financial year will be reckoned as the period between first day of April and thirty first day of March inclusive
The employer is not responsible for any delay in accessing E- procurement portal
The Cost of the tender form shall not be refundable

If any, additional information required, the same may be obtained from the office of the Executive Engineer, PWD, No. 2 Building Division, Bangalore during office hours on all working days. It may be noted that if any of the dates mentioned above happened to be a General Holiday, the next working day will be considered
Agency Should upload Employees provident fund (EPF) & ESI registration certificate, and also should upload copy of receipt of the last six months for the payment made for the same
Tenderers must provide insurance to all the employees executing this work

technicalCriterionList.description: 3.2 (b) To qualify for award of this contract each tenderer in his name should have in the last five years i.e 2021-22 to 2025-26. Satisfactory completed as a prime contractor for at least One Similar work to an extent of 50% of the contract value not less than Rs.39.82 Lakhs

3.2 (c) To qualify for award of this contract each tenderer in his name should have in the last five years 2021-22 to 2025-26. Executed in any one year, the following minimum quantities of work (1) Engaging Computer operator/Typist- 115 months, (2) Engaging watchmen/Peon/ Helper/Office Boy-132 months
valid kpwd license Class iii & above

3.3 (b) Liquid assets and /or availability of credit facilities of not less than Rs.23.89 lakhs (Credit lines/ letter of credit/ certificates from nationalized /scheduled banks) for meeting the fund requirement etc.

3.2(a) To qualify for award of this contract each tenderer in his name should have in the last five years i.e 2021-22 to 2025-26. Achieved in at least two financial years an average annual financial turnover of Rs.79.63 Lakhs (usually not less than estimated cost under this contract for works)
